points.name: 被 passive, 使/让 causative, 连...也/都...
points.explain: 被 marks a passive sentence: Object + 被 + Doer + Verb ("was [verb]ed by..."). 使 and 让 both mean "to make/let someone do something": Someone + 使/让 + Person + Result. 连...也/都... means "even...", emphasizing an extreme case.

sentences.en: The phone was borrowed by him.
I was praised by the teacher.
Even the teacher doesn't recognize him.
Although [he's] very busy, yet he's happy.
